enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe rhythmically. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Sleep.

Wake up. Sit up on bed. Swing legs over side. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open door. Turn on light. Turn on faucet. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Spit. Rinse mouth. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off faucet. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out cereal. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Take out spoon. Close cabinet. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up spoon. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Put bowl in sink. Rinse bowl. Put spoon in sink. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close closet. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Check bag. Pick up phone. Put phone in pocket. Walk out.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open door. Sit in driver seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Start engine. Adjust mirror. Drive. Stop at red light. Turn steering wheel. Park car. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Get out. Lock car. Walk to hospital entrance.

Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to nurses station. Pick up patient chart. Read notes. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart. Listen to lungs. Adjust IV drip. Administer medication. Write notes. Walk to next patient.
Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Choose food. Pay cashier. Find table. Sit down. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Check phone. Throw trash. Return tray. Walk back to ward.

Attend meeting. Discuss patient cases. Review charts. Perform procedure. Administer medication. Monitor patient. Write notes. Walk to lab. Collect samples. Return to ward. Update records. Consult with doctor. Assist patient. Walk to next room.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open door. Sit in driver seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Start engine. Drive. Stop at red light. Turn steering wheel. Park car. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Get out. Lock car. Walk to house. Open door. Enter house. Close door.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out food. Close refrigerator. Turn on stove. Cook food. Stir. Turn off stove. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Put plate in sink. Rinse plate. Turn off light. Walk out.
Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Change channels. Watch show. Adjust volume. Check phone. Change channel. Watch show. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk out.
Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Type. Use mouse. Click. Type. Scroll. Watch video. Type. Turn off computer. Close laptop. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust water temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub. Rinse. Turn off water. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Hang towel. Put on pajamas. Turn off light. Walk out.
Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Type. Use mouse. Click. Type. Scroll. Watch video. Type. Turn off computer. Close laptop. Turn off light. Walk out.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on faucet. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Spit. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Wipe face. Turn off faucet. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to bedroom. Turn off light. Lie on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe rhythmically. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Breathe. Sleep.
